<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>Squad.NET</id>
    <version>1.0.2</version>
    <authors>ultimatepritam</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <icon>icon.png</icon>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://squad.ultimatepritam.dev/</projectUrl>
    <description>The complete Squad.NET multi-agent orchestration framework - includes Abstractions, Core, OpenAI-compatible, OpenRouter, Bedrock, Ollama, LM Studio, DependencyInjection, and Hosting</description>
    <tags>ai llm multi-agent dotnet orchestration agents tools hosting aspnetcore ollama lmstudio</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/ultimatepritam/Squad.NET" commit="beaa8e6364ac54545af65b3a76448f4feb0d1c8c" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework="net8.0">
        <dependency id="Squad.Abstractions" version="1.0.2" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Squad.Bedrock" version="1.0.2" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Squad.Core" version="1.0.2" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Squad.DependencyInjection" version="1.0.2" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Squad.Hosting" version="1.0.2" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Squad.LMStudio" version="1.0.2" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Squad.Ollama" version="1.0.2" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Squad.OpenAI" version="1.0.2" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
        <dependency id="Squad.OpenRouter" version="1.0.2" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
